$comment: Godot's web export uses fixed filenames (index.wasm, index.pck) with no
content hash, so 'immutable' caching is wrong: a new build reuses the same
names and browsers would keep serving the old game forever, or worse, pair
a new index.html with a stale pck.
'no-cache' does NOT mean 'do not store'. It means 'always revalidate', so
the browser sends an If-None-Match and gets a cheap 304 when nothing has
changed. The 35 MB wasm is still only re-downloaded when it actually
changes, and a plain reload always picks up a new build.
